{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Giant Inca stones with a view over the city, and Inti (the sun) warming the ramparts."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"A riot of fruit, flowers and chatter where Cusco does its daily shopping."},{"poi_id":"p18","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wood-fired pizzas and honest pastas, with proper vegetarian plates for the crew."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Gold, textiles and mummies that tell the Inca story from the inside."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Cobbled lanes, blue doors and little workshops where artisans still do their thing."},{"poi_id":"p16","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A modern take on Andean flavours, with a vegetarian menu that feels like a treat."}]}
